name: Aspect Ratio Calculator
description: Calculate and lock aspect ratios, with the frame etched live on a camera viewfinder; presets, common sizes, CSS aspect-ratio.

name: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
description: Encode text or files to Base64 and decode it back, punched onto an 80-column card as you type. UTF-8, URL-safe, padding control.

name: Binary Converter
description: Text to binary and back on a front panel of lamps and switches, with decimal, hex and octal readouts for any number.

name: Case Converter

name: Color Converter

name: Diff Checker

name: Epoch/Human Date Converter
description: Unix timestamps to dates in any zone and back, on a core log of computer time whose marker drops to the moment you enter.

name: Hash Generator

name: Fancy Text Generator

name: Invisible Character

name: HTML Entity Encoder
description: Encode special characters to HTML entities and decode them back on a 1940s decoder ring, with a searchable code book of every named entity.

name: JSON Formatter and Minifier

name: JSON to YAML/CSV Converter
description: JSON, YAML and CSV in any direction on a three-part carbonless form: write on one sheet, the other two copies fill in, tear one off to copy.

name: JWT Decoder
description: Decode and verify JSON Web Tokens as a passport: claims on the data page, the expiry stamped red or green, HS/RS/ES signature checks in the browser.

name: Lorem Ipsum Generator

name: Morse Code Converter

name: Secure Password Generator

name: SVG Placeholder Generator

name: Transparent PNG Generator

name: Unix Timestamp Converter
description: Epoch to date and back on a split-flap departures board: local, UTC, ISO 8601 and relative, with a ticking epoch clock.

name: URL Encoder/Decoder

name: UUID/GUID Generator

name: Word Frequency Counter

name: Zalgo Text Generator
description: Turn any text into cursed glitch text with stacked Unicode marks: adjustable intensity, one-click copy.
